# account

Imported from `@adrifer/winix` (not passed to feature bodies).

## account.user()

A user on NixOS and macOS hosts, with its Home Manager configuration (so
`home.*` has someone to apply to). Call the result to include it in a
host; pass it to a WSL distro's `setup.user`.

```ts
export const alice = account.user("alice", () => ({ admin: true, shell: "zsh", stateVersion: "25.05" }));
host("wsl", platforms.wsl({ stateVersion: "25.05" }), [alice()]);
```

```ts
account.user(name: string, factory: (...args: T) => AccountOpts): AccountUserFactory<T>
```

**`factory` returns**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `admin?` | `boolean` | On NixOS, add the user to `wheel`. |
| `shell?` | `PackageRef` | Login shell, by package name ("zsh") or reference. Also enables the shell's NixOS or nix-darwin program. |
| `description?` | `string` | The user's full name or description. |
| `homeDirectory?` | `string` | The home directory. Defaults to /home/<name>, or /Users/<name> on macOS. |
| `home?` | `string` | Same as `homeDirectory`. |
| `stateVersion?` | `string` | Home Manager's `home.stateVersion`: the release this user's Home Manager setup started on. |
| `sessionVariables?` | `Record<string, string>` | Home Manager session variables. |
| `groups?` | `string[]` | NixOS groups to add the user to. |
| `extraGroups?` | `string[]` | More NixOS groups (merged with `groups`). |
| `uid?` | `number` | The user id. |
| `gid?` | `number` | The primary group id (macOS). |
| `group?` | `string` | The primary group (NixOS). |
| `isNormalUser?` | `boolean` | A normal (login) user. Defaults to true unless `isSystemUser`. |
| `isSystemUser?` | `boolean` | A system user, without a login. |
| `packages?` | `PackageRef[]` | Packages for this user (NixOS). |
| `openssh?` | `{ authorizedKeys?: string[]; authorizedKeyFiles?: string[]; }` | SSH keys that may log in as this user. |
| `hashedPasswordFile?` | `string` | A file with the user's hashed password (NixOS). |
| `homeManager?` | `Fragment` | More Home Manager configuration for this user, as a fragment. |
| `wslDefault?` | `boolean` | Make the user `wsl.defaultUser` on NixOS-WSL, unless the host sets one. |

**`openssh`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `authorizedKeys?` | `string[]` | Public keys, as text. |
| `authorizedKeyFiles?` | `string[]` | Files with public keys. |

## account.group()

A group on NixOS and macOS hosts.

```ts
account.group(name: string, factory?: (...args: T) => AccountGroupOpts): AccountGroupFactory<T>
```

**`factory` returns**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gid?` | `number` | The group id. |
| `members?` | `AccountGroupMember[]` | Users in the group, by name or by their `account.user` value. |
